name: Cyber Peace Foundation
description: India's leading NGO for digital safety and cybercrime awareness. Works with schools, governments, and youth on digital rights and online protection.

name: iCall – TISS
description: Free telephone and email counseling service run by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS). Provides mental health support for young people experiencing trauma, including digital abuse.

name: Childline India
description: India's national helpline for children in distress, available 24/7. Free, confidential support for anyone under 18 experiencing abuse, including online and image-based violence.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: Official Government of India portal for reporting cybercrime. Accepts anonymous reports. Dedicated Women and Child helpline. Available 24/7.

name: Pratham
description: One of India's largest education NGOs. Works with adolescents across rural and urban India on digital literacy and safety education.
